fileComplaint.label: File a complaint
fileComplaint.description: Paperwork against a faction vein. Its security upgrades stall for a few days.
fileComplaint.log: Complaint filed. %s will be tied up in paperwork.

tipPolice.label: Tip off the police
tipPolice.description: An anonymous word to the Met. The faction's goods sell for less while they're watched.
tipPolice.log: Tip passed on. %s will be selling under scrutiny.

leakTicker.label: Leak to the Ticker
leakTicker.description: Feed the press something the faction would rather keep quiet. Pulls the Ticker against what they want.
leakTicker.headline: Leaked papers embarrass %s
leakTicker.log: Leak placed. The Ticker will turn on %s.
